headline: Silver Falls 1.86 Percent To $53.28 As Money Leaves Precious Metals
narrative: Silver fell 1.86 percent to $53.28, with money leaving the precious-metals pipe. Gold eased 0.52 percent to $4,053.60, so that pipe gave up ground on both metals. Crude oil rose 1.54 percent to $101.44 and copper rose 0.42 percent to $6.65, an energy and industrial bid that moved apart from silver and gold.
author: jordan
